title: The Right Lease
space: the student's own namespace `students/{user}`, database `app_{user}`, fork and app slot
goal: The app needs DB credentials valid 2 minutes and never longer than 10 minutes in total. Make it so on a **new** role called `c2-app`, and get a credential from it.
verify_text: in `students/{user}`: database role `c2-app` has `default_ttl=2m`, `max_ttl=10m`, and a credential was issued from it (lease exists).
isolation: each student has their own database `app_{user}` and their own `database/` engine.
hints: TTL and max TTL are separate settings.
On the role, not on the mount.
